text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As an umamusume of the Mejiro house,
"Never let victory get to your head" is our creed~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So that I don't just float away,
I must keep my feet firmly planted on the ground...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: I think it's okay to celebrate right now.
Let's dig in and keep holding on just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~? Then I shall leave it to you
to be excited on my behalf, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You did it, indeed~. Congratulations~.
So fluffy~, so fluffy~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get fired up right away
for our next victory~!
